svg.text: Simula Creative Loop Agent — system architecture
One round = one Statsig experiment. Pi Durable checkpoints every phase, so a crash or Ctrl-C resumes where it stopped.
Pi Durable harness · app.loop → app.round (×1+3) → app.video (×8 parallel)
runs/<id>/harness.sqlite holds the strategist conversation; every phase is idempotent against the run directory
audience model → simulated users (the agent never sees it)
External services (all paid calls go through src/llm.ts → ledger + budget guard)
OpenRouter · openai/gpt-image-2.6-sunburst — keyframes (cached by layer hash)
Statsig Console API — create / start / attach metrics / conclude
Statsig server SDK — getExperiment(user).get('variant_id'), exposures + events
